field_guidance.provider: Opaque confirmed integration name; reference resolves the target-owned integration document or section, which states the packet home and size limit (the change-request description by default, or a durable note the description points to), the stale-head rejection behind exact-head direct merge (proved by setup's live stale-head probe where the provider documents none), and that queueing not bindable to a head is refused as sha-bound-action-unsupported.
field_guidance.profile_path: Confirmed invoked-target profile pointer, never an installed default.
field_guidance.tracker: Independently confirmed work-item system/repository or local filesystem scope, tools and operation limits.
field_guidance.agent_setup_docs: Confirmed target-relative paths preserving custom roots and additions.
field_guidance.label_vocabulary: Live target vocabulary and target triage-role mapping; no shared label default.
field_guidance.check_gate: Target policy ref, exact local command, runtime and bootstrap route.
field_guidance.dev_workflows: Target policy and runtime-specific complete declaration pointers.
field_guidance.branch_naming: Target source-branch policy, not a native identifier validator.
field_guidance.ci_parity: Independently scoped configured advisory CI and binding limits.
field_guidance.release_deploy_policy: Target policy; configuration alone never grants action authority.
field_guidance.manual_validation_rules: Target acceptance surfaces, evidence and feasibility limits.

runtime_skill_resources.execution: <skill-name>/<path> names a file inside an installed skill, not a path from the declaring file; resolve it to a real filesystem path before invoking helpers. Relative paths inside that file resolve against the directory of the file that contains them.

resource_addressing.installed_aliases: Classify by underlying source; project-owned native aliases never establish the invoked target's profile.
